types.name: marketoverview.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode is a stable domain error code enum for Market Overview.
 It is used for consistent error surfaces across ConnectRPC and REST.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc: ErrorDetail carries a typed domain error code for machine-readable handling.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code for programmatic matching.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetSpotVolumeHistoryRequest
types.doc: A finite spot-volume chart request; no pagination or arbitrary time range.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc:
Pair IDs from GetSpotConfig; empty selects every configured pair separately.
 At most 2000 distinct positive IDs. Unknown IDs are rejected. If the full
 universe exceeds 2000 pairs, specify a filter; results are never truncated.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.GetSpotVolumeHistoryResponse
types.doc:
Aligned columnar trailing-24h USD series over the most recent 24 hours.
 The grid always contains 97 samples ending at the latest completed UTC
 quarter-hour. Index i maps to start_ts_sec + i * 900 seconds. Each sample
 covers [sample time - 24h, sample time); only the preceding 48 hours contribute.
 USD conversion uses the latest trustworthy quote/USD mark at or before each
 bucket's start. Stablecoin quotes also require historical USD prices.
 If any contributing trade cannot be valued, or a USD amount overflows,
 the RPC fails as unavailable; partial or zero-filled valuations are not returned.
 Intervals without executed trades are zero. Results may be reused for 15 seconds.

fields.name: bucket
fields.doc: Sampling interval between points; currently always "15m".

fields.name: start_ts_sec
fields.doc: First sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

fields.name: end_ts_sec
fields.doc: Last sample timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch (UTC), inclusive.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Number of aligned values in every pair array and the total array; always 97.

fields.name: pairs
fields.doc: Pairs ordered by ascending symbol_id; at most 2000, each included once.

fields.name: total_volume_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Sum across selected pairs, USD scaled by 1e6. Exactly points values,
 oldest first. REST renders decimal strings in totalVolumeUsd.
 Do not sum overlapping trailing-24h samples to obtain period traded volume.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc:
Filter by stable numeric pair IDs from GetSpotConfig. When empty, returns
 all enabled markets.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of markets to return. Defaults to 50 when omitted; maximum
 is 2000.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to symbol IDs, sort key, and sort direction. Sparkline options
 affect only response enrichment and may change between pages.

fields.name: order_by
fields.doc: Sort key. When unset/UNSPECIFIED, defaults to descending 24h USD volume.

fields.name: sort
fields.doc: Sort direction (DESC=newest/highest first).

fields.name: include_sparklines
fields.doc: When true, include sparklines in each MarketOverview.

fields.name: sparkline_intervals
fields.doc:
Which sparklines to include. If empty and include_sparklines is true,
 server defaults to 24h.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc: Market overview rows for the requested page.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

values.name: ORDER_BY_VOLUME_24H_USD
values.doc: Sort by canonical USD 24h volume. Unvalued markets sort last in either direction.

values.name: ORDER_BY_LAST_PRICE
values.doc: Sort by last price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

values.name: ORDER_BY_DATE_ADDED
values.doc: Sort by listing time (new listings first).

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: last_price_ticks
fields.doc: Last traded price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: last_trade_ts_ns
fields.doc: Last trade timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

fields.name: change_24h_bps
fields.doc: Rolling 24h change expressed in basis points (bp). Example: +123 = +1.23%.

fields.name: high_24h_ticks
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h stats.
 Highest traded price in the 24h window, in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: low_24h_ticks
fields.doc: Lowest traded price in the 24h window, in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: volume_24h_base_scaled
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h base volume scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig. Omitted if the amount exceeds the signed 64-bit range.

fields.name: volume_24h_quote_scaled
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h quote volume scaled by the pair's quote_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig. Omitted if the amount exceeds the signed 64-bit range.

fields.name: volume_24h_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Rolling 24h USD volume, scaled by 1e6 (one unit is 0.000001 USD).
 Omitted if any contributing volume cannot be valued reliably. Quote volumes
 use execution prices; USD conversion uses historical quarter-hour marks.
 Covers the 24 hours ending at the latest completed UTC minute.
 Refreshed every 15 seconds after completed minutes become available.

fields.name: listed_ts_ns
fields.doc: Listing timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

fields.name: best_bid_ticks
fields.doc: Current best bid price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: best_bid_qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Best bid quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: best_ask_ticks
fields.doc: Current best ask price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: best_ask_qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Best ask quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: sparklines
fields.doc: Optional sparklines (requested explicitly).

fields.name: index_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Current multi-venue index price in quote units scaled by 1e6.
 Zero when no fresh, valid index price is available.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.MarketOverviewBatch
types.doc:
MarketOverviewBatch is a websocket payload carrying batched market overview
 updates. It is published to a single all-markets channel at a fixed cadence.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc: Market overviews included in this batch.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Batch publish timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.Sparkline
types.doc: Sparkline contains newest-first close prices for one time range.

fields.name: interval
fields.doc: Time range and sampling resolution represented by these close prices.

fields.name: close_ticks
fields.doc: Newest-first close prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

types.name: marketoverview.v1.SparklineInterval
types.doc:
SparklineInterval identifies the time range and sampling resolution for a
 sparkline.

values.name: SPARKLINE_1H
values.doc: 1 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 60 points (1-minute buckets).

values.name: SPARKLINE_24H
values.doc: 24 hour sparkline. Typically returns up to 96 points (15-minute buckets).

values.name: SPARKLINE_1W
values.doc: 1 week sparkline. Typically returns up to 168 points (1-hour buckets).

values.name: SPARKLINE_1M
values.doc: 1 month sparkline. Typically returns up to 180 points (4-hour buckets).

types.name: marketoverview.v1.SpotPairVolumeSeries
types.doc:
One pair appears exactly once, regardless of its base and quote assets.
 REST renders the scaled amounts as decimal strings in volumeUsd.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID; clients may group these series by base asset.

fields.name: volume_usd_scaled
fields.doc:
Trailing-24h USD amounts scaled by 1e6, oldest first. Exactly points values,
 aligned with the shared response grid. Zero means no executed trades in
 the window. USD values round down once per contributing 15-minute bucket.
